name: python_sample
$comment: Spec for the python-backed-method feature: api-specs/gen.py --python-out -> zig/conformance/py/rpc_py.py (the msgspec types + dispatch() the embedded-CPython bridge imports). Kept separate from sample.json so the python feature (a Python artifact) doesn't perturb the rpc_gen.zig/openrpc.json pipeline. Handler bodies are hand-written in zig/conformance/py/handlers.py, bound by symbol. The byte-exact A/B drives the SAME rpc_py.dispatch via a real embedded interpreter (Zig) and plain CPython (oracle).

GreetResult.$comment: Echoes the request name + a field read from the session-state view, proving both cross the FFI.

py.greet.summary: A Python-backed greeting; reads the session-state view and sets an audit message.

py.add.summary: A Python-backed integer add (exercises scalar decode/encode across the boundary).

py.boom.summary: Raises a JsonRpcError (exercises the error-mapping path).
